question: India celebrated the 146th birth anniversary of which of the following famous social reformers and rationalists from Tamil Nadu on 17 September 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Periyar EV Ramasamy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Periyar EV Ramasamy**, popularly known as **Periyar**, was a prominent **social reformer** and **rationalist** from Tamil Nadu.
 
• He was born on **17 September 1879** in **Erode**, Tamil Nadu, and is regarded as the **Father of the Dravidian Movement**.
 
• Periyar was a strong advocate of **social justice, equality, and self-respect**, particularly focusing on the rights and empowerment of the **marginalized communities**.
 
• He founded the **Self-Respect Movement** in 1925, aimed at eradicating caste discrimination, promoting gender equality, and opposing religious orthodoxy.
 
• Periyar was vocal against the dominance of **Brahminical ideologies** and Hindu rituals, which he believed perpetuated inequality.
 
• He played a critical role in advocating for **rationalism** and the importance of scientific temper in society.
 
• Periyar’s ideas and movements significantly influenced the political landscape of Tamil Nadu, including the rise of the **Dravidian political parties** such as the **DMK** and **AIADMK**.
 
• His contributions to social reform earned him the title of **"Vaikom Hero"** for his participation in the Vaikom Satyagraha, which fought against untouchability.
 
• Periyar’s legacy continues to be celebrated for his efforts to build an egalitarian society, and his birth anniversary is widely observed to honor his contributions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **MK Stalin**__

 __
 
• **MK Stalin** is the current **Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu** and the son of former CM **Karunanidhi**.
 
• He is a prominent political leader in Tamil Nadu, representing the **Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK)** party.
 
• MK Stalin has focused on social welfare schemes, education reform, and economic development in Tamil Nadu during his tenure.
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**__
 __
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**, also known as the **Father of the Nation** in India, was a leading figure in the Indian **freedom struggle**.
 
• He championed the principles of **non-violence (Ahimsa)** and **Satyagraha** as methods to resist colonial oppression.
 
• Gandhi’s efforts in movements like the **Salt March** and **Quit India Movement** were pivotal in India gaining independence from British rule.
 
 
 
• **Radhakrishnan**__
 
 
• **Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan** was the **second President of India** and a renowned philosopher and scholar.
 
• His birthday, **5th September**, is celebrated as **Teachers’ Day** in India, honoring his contributions to education.
 
• Radhakrishnan was an advocate for **interfaith dialogue** and a proponent of Indian philosophy on the global stage.
